page_title: FRE 2-1 BOC | Freiburg v Bochum 14/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Daniel Siebert shows a yellow card to Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) for a tough tackle.
90+3' What a big chance! Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
90+2' Samuel Bamba (Bochum) is adjudged offside.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' The goal by Freiburg is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
89' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Freiburg players aren’t happy.
88' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) fires the ball in and gets on the scoresheet!
87' Here is a change. Junior Adamu is going off and Julian Schuster gives the last tactical orders to Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg).
87' The substitution is prepared. Samuel Bamba (Bochum) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Dani de Wit.
87' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) is furious with himself for wasting a glorious chance. He got to a rebound inside the 6-yard box, but his header floated over the crossbar.

86' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Patrick Drewes guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.

83' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
82' Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum) sees a yellow card from Daniel Siebert after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
81' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Aliou Balde (Bochum) gets booked.
80' Julian Schuster decides to make a substitution. Ritsu Doan will be replaced by Lucas Holer (Freiburg).
77' It is time for a substitution. Aliou Balde (Bochum) is on for Matus Bero.
76' That's a well-taken pass by Ritsu Doan (Freiburg). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
73' The linesman signals that Junior Adamu (Freiburg) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
72' Goal, no wait. Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for handball and Lukas Daschner (Bochum) can't celebrate. Disallowed goal.
67' Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
65' The corner is swung in but Bochum can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
65' Peter Zeidler has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lukas Daschner (Bochum) replacing Myron Boadu.
65' Peter Zeidler has decided to make a change. Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) replaces Moritz Broschinski.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum) comes onto the pitch so that Koji Miyoshi can be given a rest.
61' 2 - 1 Goal! Junior Adamu (Freiburg) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:1.

61' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders.
58' 1 - 1 Goal! Junior Adamu (Freiburg) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the top right corner.
56' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Patrick Drewes, who smothers the ball.
55' Bochum can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
52' Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Daniel Siebert has a clear sight and sees a foul from Junior Adamu (Freiburg).
51' The current number of shots on goal is 5:2.
47' The resulting set piece from Freiburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

47' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots low towards goal, but Patrick Drewes makes a magnificent save! The ball goes behind for a corner. Freiburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' Julian Schuster makes a switch. Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) is coming on in place of Patrick Osterhage at the start of the second period.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Julian Schuster probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg). He is replaced by Matthias Ginter.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Daniel Siebert has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Bochum fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' 0 - 1 Goal! Myron Boadu (Bochum) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a low shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 0:1.

43' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the right post. Patrick Drewes has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
42' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
39' Merlin Rohl is substituted due to injury. Julian Schuster gives a chance to Eren Dinkci (Freiburg).
39' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bochum comes to nothing.
37' A pass lands at the feet of Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
35' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
34' The ball is cleared after Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
31' The game is interrupted as Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) is flagged offside.
27' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) misses an absolute sitter after connecting with a cross inside the penalty box.
25' Myron Boadu (Bochum) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
25' Bochum take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
23' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Patrick Drewes anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
23' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.

22' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Patrick Drewes leaps like a salmon to deny him.
20' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle and signals a foul after Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) brought his opponent down.
18' A corner kick by Freiburg is thwarted by the well prepared Patrick Drewes (Bochum).
18' Freiburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Freiburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
17' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Freiburg have a corner.
13' A dangerous towering header by Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
13' The ball is out of play. Freiburg will have a chance to score from a corner.

13' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Corner kick. Freiburg will have an opportunity.
11' Freiburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
9' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) is penalised for a foul. Daniel Siebert had a clear view and blows his whistle.
5' Jakov Medic (Bochum) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
5' The ball goes out for a corner. Bochum can continue in their attacking effort.
4' Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Bochum.
4' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) should have done it better. He won the ball from the resulting free kick, but fired high over the crossbar.
2' Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.
1' The first half has started.
Bochum will kick the game off.
Daniel Siebert will supervise the game today.
